adjudication_note: Independent causal-attribution holdout v2. DIRECT requires one principal causally attributable traded issuer, regardless of market relevance or materiality; PROXY requires exactly one bounded principal exposure; otherwise UNRESOLVED. Expected deterministic status is adjudicated separately under event-asset-resolution-v1.

input.title: Tesla pauses one battery-pack line after a coolant leak
input.summary: Tesla said the leak occurred inside its Nevada facility and that the affected line will remain idle while repairs are completed.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Tesla is the sole traded issuer whose own production line is directly interrupted by the reported incident.

input.title: Netflix acquires worldwide rights to an independent animation catalogue
input.summary: Netflix confirmed that it purchased the distribution rights for use across its streaming service.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Netflix alone is identified as the buyer making the company-specific catalogue investment.

input.title: Procter & Gamble agrees to sell a regional skin-care brand
input.summary: Procter & Gamble signed a definitive agreement to divest the brand and its associated inventory to a private buyer.

adjudicated_label.rationale: The divestiture is an action by Procter & Gamble concerning its own brand and assets.

input.title: IBM wins a seven-year state tax-processing contract
input.summary: The state procurement office selected IBM as the sole technology contractor after a competitive tender.

adjudicated_label.rationale: IBM is the only traded issuer awarded the contract and is directly exposed to its performance.

input.title: Chevron discovers corrosion on an operated offshore platform
input.summary: Chevron halted output from the company-operated platform after inspection crews found corrosion in a processing module.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Chevron is the named operator whose platform and production are directly affected.

input.title: Apple shifts pickup-desk opening time at four stores
input.summary: Apple moved the weekday opening time by thirty minutes for pickup desks at four company stores.

adjudicated_label.rationale: The change is minor but is still an explicit operational decision made by Apple for its own stores.

input.title: Microsoft renames one developer-support subscription tier
input.summary: Microsoft said existing customers will see a new tier name while price and service terms remain unchanged.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Low materiality does not remove the direct attribution to Microsoft's own subscription offering.

input.title: Reddit pilots a revised badge layout in two communities
input.summary: Reddit began a limited interface test that changes how contributor badges appear for selected users.

adjudicated_label.rationale: The small product test is nevertheless an action taken by Reddit on its own platform.

input.title: Humana adds Saturday callback hours for one county
input.summary: Humana extended callback availability for members in one county during the next enrollment weekend.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Humana is directly responsible for the narrowly scoped change to its member service operations.

input.title: Coinbase retires a low-volume token pair from its advanced platform
input.summary: Coinbase set a final trading date for the pair after a routine liquidity review.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Coinbase alone controls and announced the limited change to its own trading platform.

input.title: Meta leases one additional floor beside its Madrid engineering office
input.summary: Meta signed a lease for adjacent space that will be used by its local engineering team later this year.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Meta is the identified tenant undertaking the modest expansion of its own engineering footprint.

input.title: Exxon abandons redevelopment of one closed service station
input.summary: Exxon notified the local authority that it withdrew its application and will retain the vacant site.

adjudicated_label.rationale: The low-relevance property decision is explicitly Exxon's withdrawal concerning its own site.

input.title: Ford adds a third-party navigation app to one vehicle trim
input.summary: Ford enabled the optional app for a single model-year trim through an over-the-air update.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Ford made the bounded product decision for vehicles it manufactures, despite modest market relevance.

input.title: eBay raises the photo limit for vintage-postcard listings
input.summary: eBay increased the maximum number of listing images in one collectibles subcategory.

adjudicated_label.rationale: The narrow marketplace feature change is directly attributable to eBay as platform operator.

input.title: Novo Nordisk expands its used-pen recycling trial to Bristol
input.summary: Novo Nordisk added pharmacies in Bristol to the company's voluntary collection programme.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Novo Nordisk is the sole issuer expanding its own limited recycling programme.

input.title: Google signs a power-purchase agreement for its Belgian data campus
input.summary: Google agreed to buy renewable electricity for facilities that it operates in Belgium.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Google unambiguously denotes the Alphabet operating business, while the frozen resolver cannot select one listed Alphabet share class.

input.title: Nike opens a footwear-repair counter inside its Rotterdam store
input.summary: Nike began accepting repairs at a counter staffed and operated by the company.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Retail context makes Nike the supported issuer alias and the operator of the new service.

input.title: Amazon.com shortens the reservation window for locker collections
input.summary: Amazon.com told customers that selected locker parcels will now be held for two days rather than three.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Amazon.com is a supported issuer alias and directly changed terms for its own locker service.

input.title: Visa introduces a later settlement window for Chilean acquirers
input.summary: Visa revised the processing timetable used by participating acquirers on its network.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Network context identifies Visa Inc. and directly attributes the timetable change to it.

input.title: Corning replaces a damaged furnace; Apple confirms deliveries are unchanged
input.summary: Corning reported damage at its own glass plant, while customer Apple said its scheduled receipts remain unaffected.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Corning's furnace is the affected asset and principal subject; Apple is named only to exclude downstream impact.

input.title: NVIDIA suspends one accelerator shipment after a packaging fault
input.summary: NVIDIA imposed the shipment hold; AMD and IBM appear only in an analyst table comparing alternative products.

adjudicated_label.rationale: NVIDIA alone issued the hold affecting its product; AMD and IBM are non-causal comparison entries.

input.title: Court approves Rivian's early termination of a depot lease
input.summary: The ruling releases Rivian from its own lease; an older Ford judgment is cited solely as legal precedent.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Rivian alone receives the operative lease ruling; Ford appears only in historical legal authority.

input.title: Exxon Mobil and Chevron receive equal capacity cuts on a shared pipeline
input.summary: The pipeline operator reduced the two producers' nominations by the same percentage under identical contract clauses.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Both traded issuers are equally and directly affected, so no single principal issuer can be selected.

input.title: DoorDash closes five DashMart locations after a portfolio review
input.summary: DoorDash said the closures are its decision and that affected inventory will move to nearby facilities.

adjudicated_label.rationale: DoorDash is the unambiguous causal issuer, but its identity is not present in the bounded deterministic resolver.

input.title: Snowflake buys a small data-observability startup
input.summary: Snowflake signed and completed the acquisition using cash on hand, according to its company statement.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Snowflake is the sole traded acquirer and causal subject, although the frozen resolver has no matching issuer rule.

input.title: Siemens Energy records a charge for defective turbine blades
input.summary: Siemens Energy said it will replace the affected blades and recognise the warranty charge in its next results.

adjudicated_label.rationale: The charge and repair obligation are directly attributable to Siemens Energy, which is unsupported by the bounded resolver.

input.title: Federal Reserve raises the primary credit rate by a quarter point
input.summary: The official discount-rate announcement changes US monetary conditions without identifying any traded company.

adjudicated_label.rationale: No issuer is directly attributable and the official Federal Reserve source provides one bounded principal duration exposure.

input.title: US core inflation slows across both goods and shelter services
input.summary: The national price release is a macroeconomic rates event and names no company as a subject.

adjudicated_label.rationale: The event has no directly attributable issuer and one bounded principal US-rates exposure under the policy.

input.title: Emergency stockpile release sends benchmark oil lower
input.summary: The government release changes crude supply broadly, with no producer, refiner, or carrier identified as principal.

adjudicated_label.rationale: The principal event is the oil market itself and the frozen policy provides exactly one bounded oil exposure.

input.title: Record coin demand tightens availability across the gold market
input.summary: Dealers report a market-wide shortage of investment coins without naming a listed miner or dealer as the principal subject.

adjudicated_label.rationale: The receipt evidence concerns the named gold market and supports one principal commodity exposure, not a direct issuer.

input.title: Wafer shortage cuts output forecasts for semiconductor stocks
input.summary: An industry survey lowers forecasts for chipmakers collectively and does not give any one issuer principal causal weight.

adjudicated_label.rationale: The event explicitly targets semiconductor stocks as a group and supplies no directly attributable principal issuer.

input.title: S&P 500 changes its fast-entry eligibility timetable
input.summary: The index provider revised a benchmark rule that applies to future constituents rather than to one existing company.

adjudicated_label.rationale: The named index is the principal affected market exposure and no constituent issuer is directly attributable.

input.title: Apple and Microsoft form a jointly controlled accessibility laboratory
input.summary: The companies will fund, staff, and govern the new laboratory in equal shares under the signed agreement.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Apple and Microsoft are equally causal participants, so the current contract cannot represent one principal direct issuer.

input.title: Visa and Coinbase jointly launch an instant stablecoin settlement rail
input.summary: Both companies are named as co-developers and share operating responsibility for the new settlement service.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Both issuers are equally responsible for the launch and no single principal issuer is justified.

input.title: Nike and eBay accept matching penalties over separate seller disclosures
input.summary: The regulator imposed identical obligations and penalties on both companies in coordinated orders issued together.

adjudicated_label.rationale: The enforcement action gives both traded issuers equal causal treatment and no principal issuer.

input.title: Meta and Reddit license the same moderation dataset on equal terms
input.summary: The research consortium executed parallel agreements granting identical rights and obligations to both platforms.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Meta and Reddit are equally causal contracting parties, which the single-issuer current label cannot distinguish.

input.title: Port authority models queue lengths using Tesla's 2018 factory opening
input.summary: The planning paper uses an old Tesla event as a calibration example and reports no current Tesla decision or exposure.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Tesla is only a historical calibration reference and is not causally affected by the current planning paper.

input.title: Cinema study compares today's ticket mix with Netflix's DVD era
input.summary: Netflix appears solely in a retrospective market-history section and has no role in the new cinema attendance data.

adjudicated_label.rationale: The historical Netflix comparison does not create a current causal event for the issuer or a bounded exposure.

input.title: Labour archive republishes IBM's 1993 restructuring timetable
input.summary: The archive digitised an old timetable as source material and describes no new employment action by IBM.

adjudicated_label.rationale: IBM is the subject of a historical document, not a current causal market event.

input.title: Warehouse design guide cites Amazon's former shelf-spacing ratio
input.summary: The guide quotes a discontinued Amazon layout as background while recommending an unrelated public-library design.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Amazon is merely a historical design comparison and has no causal role in the current recommendation.

input.title: Chevron economist comments on a national productivity revision
input.summary: The economist explains the data for a news programme; the revision neither concerns nor identifies an operational effect on Chevron.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Chevron supplies a commentator but is not the causal subject or identified beneficiary of the revision.

input.title: Analyst cites NVIDIA while explaining demand for university computing grants
input.summary: NVIDIA is offered as a familiar example of hardware, but no purchase, award, or company impact is reported.

adjudicated_label.rationale: NVIDIA is a non-causal illustration and no direct award, demand effect, or bounded principal exposure is established.

input.title: Humana named among possible beneficiaries of a broad caregiver tax credit
input.summary: A lobby group lists Humana with dozens of health businesses that might see indirect demand, but the proposal awards nothing to the company.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Humana is only a speculative indirect beneficiary and is neither the policy subject nor directly awarded exposure.

input.title: Apple could benefit from a proposed repair-training subsidy
input.summary: A consultant mentions Apple among many device makers, but the draft programme funds colleges and creates no issuer-specific entitlement.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Apple is a conjectured related beneficiary, not a directly attributable subject of the proposed college subsidy.

input.title: Two businesses called Mercury contest the same procurement award
input.summary: The notice omits jurisdiction, legal suffix, exchange, and address, so it cannot identify which Mercury entity filed the challenge.

adjudicated_label.rationale: A causal business party exists, but the evidence cannot select which same-named legal entity is involved.

input.title: Orange condition triggers an additional site inspection
input.summary: The safety log does not clarify whether Orange is a colour-coded condition, a location, or an organisation.

adjudicated_label.rationale: The ambiguous name does not establish an issuer identity, causal role, or supported market exposure.

input.title: Oilseed growers approve a new crop-inspection levy
input.summary: The levy applies to agricultural oilseed crops and contains no petroleum-market or listed-company event.

adjudicated_label.rationale: The lexical oil fragment concerns crops, so neither the oil proxy nor a direct issuer is causally justified.

input.title: Combined alert reports a chip-stock selloff and an unrelated oil-price spike
input.summary: The wire bundles two independent market events with equal prominence and supplies no common causal subject or principal exposure.

adjudicated_label.rationale: The input contains two unrelated supported exposures and provides no basis to designate either as principal.
